text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: This is the perfect amount of extra flour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower enters the kitchen with a
spring in
her step. Interested, I take a
peek.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the hold up! Let's get it right
this time!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Proceeding to the dough
kneading
phase.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello! We're making desserts.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Not just any desserts. The mission is to
create
sweets for a wedding.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a good friend of mine asked me for
help.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're going to make desserts for your
sister's
wedding?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wanted to go the extra mile for
her
special day! But I couldn't think of
any good
ideas...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
I tried a bunch of different sweets, but
nothing
stuck. If only I were as creative
as you...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, if you'd like, I can try making a
few
desserts! They might give you some
ideas!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you so much! I'll keep

experimenting on my own too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So here we are. But I've hit a wall... I
don't know
what kinds of dessert are
suitable for a wedding.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Flower is currently
experiencing a
"deadlock." Introducing
an additional factor may
resolve the
issue.
choice_data_list: 他の誰かを頼ってみてもいいんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recalling Tracen Academy student
database...
Optimal match found. Flash's
parents are
confectioners by trade.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Sky told me something
similar
once.
choice_data_list: 1人で気負い過ぎても疲れるよ

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go ask Flash for advice! It
might give
me some good ideas!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. One minute and twenty-three
seconds until
it reaches optimal firmness.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Forty minutes and fifteen seconds until
the dough
is done baking. We'll ready
the decorations in the
meantime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Top it off with equal portions of
seasonal fruit,
then evenly apply the
whipped cream...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Perfection.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Your precision is incredible! And
the
decorations are so extravagant.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Did it give you any good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No... not yet. I can't help but
second-guess
myself, since I'm just an
amateur...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, my father told me
that it
doesn't matter if you're a pro or
an amateur when
putting the finishing
touches on confectionery.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
You know, baking sweets is just like
wishing
someone happiness.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
You can have a detailed recipe and the
finest
ingredients, but only when you
mix in your love
do you get the delicious
final product.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So instead of worrying about the result,
have
faith in the care you put in.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The care... I put in...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's always helping me out, so I
want to
give back...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (That's why I jumped at the chance to be there for my friend. I can't believe I forgot!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Update detected in Flower's status.
"Enthusiasm"
parameter increasing.
Flash, does this indicate...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ja. It seems like she's found her answer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Some roses to decorate the financier
cake, and a
few African daisies on the
meringue... and then to
wrap it all up in
a bouquet of baby's breath...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There! The perfect trio of flowers—love,
hope,
and a wish for happiness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the other day!
My friend
said her sister loved it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I made something to thank the both of
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
These are the sweets bouquets you
devised for
Operation Wedding
Desserts... Are these for us?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ♪ They're just the mini versions,
but they're
full of my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: They look delectable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ja... Because they were made with care.
